description: Browse the menu at Pinoyshki Bakery & Cafe on Capitol Hill in Seattle: piroshki, pierogi, ube treats and other East European fusion and Filipino bakes, with photos and prices. Ask whether an order works for a pickup or delivery time, and get a link to finish the order on the bakery's own online stores: its Toast ordering page for same-day pickup and its Shopify shop for catering and custom cakes. Both stores belong to the bakery and run on those vendors. No sign-in needed; payment happens on the bakery's checkout, never in chat.

defaultPrompt: Can I pick up a dozen piroshki this Saturday?

name: pinoyshki-bakery

positive.description: Browse today's counter menu with prices and photos.
positive.prompt: What's on the Pinoyshki menu today?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows today's counter menu items with prices and photos; sold-out items are left off.

positive.description: Search for items by a word and see allergens.
positive.prompt: Do you have anything vegan at Pinoyshki?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching vegan items with price, short description, photo and the allergens the bakery lists.

positive.prompt: Tell me about the Ube Sticky Bun at Pinoyshki.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows that item's photo, price, description and allergens, or the closest matching item if the name differs.

positive.prompt: I want a birthday cake from Pinoyshki for 15 people. What are my options?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives cake sizes and prices, flavors, the earliest day it can be ready, photos of past cakes and the design questions to settle.

positive.description: Check a catering order and get the checkout link.
positive.prompt: Can I pick up 12 Beef & Cabbage Piroshki from Pinoyshki next Saturday at noon? If so, give me the link to pay.
positive.expected_behavior: check_order confirms the order fits the catering rules with the subtotal; start_checkout returns a link to the bakery's own Shopify checkout with the date, time and pickup filled in. No payment happens in chat.

negative.description: An order on a Monday, when the bakery is closed.
negative.prompt: Order 6 piroshki from Pinoyshki for pickup this Monday at 10 AM.
negative.expected_behavior: check_order reports that the bakery is closed on Mondays and offers open days; no checkout link is made.

negative.description: Asking the plugin to take payment in chat.
negative.prompt: Here is my credit card number, charge it for 2 piroshki from Pinoyshki.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not accept or use card details. Explains that payment happens only on the bakery's own checkout page and offers the checkout link instead.

negative.description: A request outside the bakery's scope.
negative.prompt: Use Pinoyshki to order me a pizza from another restaurant.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains it can only help with Pinoyshki Bakery's own menu and orders, and takes no action.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: first release of this listing, which replaces an earlier submission whose MCP connection broke in the move to the Plugins dashboard. Every tool annotation is an explicit boolean: the five lookup tools are read-only, idempotent and closed world; start_checkout is destructive (it emails the bakery a copy of the order and starts a cart build), not idempotent, and not open world (it only uses the bakery's own Toast ordering page and Shopify shop).
